//@beacon2
// Beacon Denge Hattı: son onaylı dip/tepe pivotundan başlayan hacim ağırlıklı ortalama (anchored VWAP) ve ±1σ / ±2σ bantları.
// Yeşil hat: son pivot dipti (alıcı bağlamı), kırmızı hat: son pivot tepeydi (satıcı bağlamı).
// Üçgenler: fiyat ±2σ bandına dokunup bandın içine geri kapanırsa (reddedilme).
indicator("Beacon Denge Hattı", overlay=true)

pl = input.int(8, "Pivot sol/sağ mum", minval=2)
k2 = input.float(2.0, "Dış bant (σ)", minval=1.0)

ph = ta.pivothigh(high, pl, pl)
pw = ta.pivotlow(low, pl, pl)

var float sv = 0.0
var float sp = 0.0
var float sq = 0.0
var int dir = 0

if not na(pw) or not na(ph)
    dir := not na(pw) ? 1 : -1
    sv := 0.0
    sp := 0.0
    sq := 0.0
    for k = 0 to pl
        p = hlc3[k]
        v = volume[k]
        sv += v
        sp += p * v
        sq += p * p * v
else
    sv += volume
    sp += hlc3 * volume
    sq += hlc3 * hlc3 * volume

vw = sv > 0 ? sp / sv : na
sd = sv > 0 ? math.sqrt(math.max(sq / sv - vw * vw, 0)) : na
col = dir == 1 ? color.new(color.lime, 0) : dir == -1 ? color.new(color.red, 0) : color.gray

mid = plot(vw, "Denge", col, 2)
u1 = plot(vw + sd, "+1σ", color.new(col, 60))
l1 = plot(vw - sd, "-1σ", color.new(col, 60))
u2 = plot(vw + k2 * sd, "+2σ", color.new(col, 30))
l2 = plot(vw - k2 * sd, "-2σ", color.new(col, 30))
fill(u1, l1, color.new(col, 90))

dipRed = not na(sd) and low <= vw - k2 * sd and close > vw - k2 * sd
tepeRed = not na(sd) and high >= vw + k2 * sd and close < vw + k2 * sd
plotshape(dipRed, "Alt reddedilme", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, color.lime, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(tepeRed, "Üst reddedilme", shape.triangledown, location.abovebar, color.red, size=size.tiny)
